FIELDS.NAME: Summit Sporting Goods
FIELDS.GL CODE: Retail Sporting Goods Store - General Liability Code
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Summit Sporting Goods operates a retail sporting goods store specializing in non-motorized sporting products such as athletic apparel, footwear, and general fitness equipment. Our extensive inventory caters to a wide range of athletic pursuits, including running, cycling, and team sports. As part of our commitment to safety and customer satisfaction, we ensure that all instructional activities are conducted by certified staff with documented safety protocols. Our retail environment is designed to be welcoming and informative, where customers receive guidance on product usage, promoting an engaging shopping experience. We strictly adhere to all local, state, and federal safety regulations, ensuring that our operations minimize liability risks while maintaining compliance with safety standards. Given our focus on non-motorized sporting goods and our strict protocols, we do not engage in the sale or rental of firearms or ammunition, aligning with industry best practices to manage liability exposure effectively.

Our sporting goods store specializes in a wide range of outdoor and recreational equipment, including a dedicated section for firearms and ammunition, which accounts for a portion of our annual sales.
